heroHeadline: UEFA Fights FIFA Subsidiaries' Bid to Join Infantino Discovery Case
heroSubtitle: UEFA urged a Manhattan federal court on Sep 10 to reject an attempt by FIFA's American subsidiaries, FIFA (Americas) Inc and FWC2026 US Inc, to intervene in UEFA's bid to obtain evidence for a planned Swiss criminal complaint against FIFA president Gianni Infantino over the abandoned $4.2 billion World Cup stake-sale plan. UEFA called the subsidiaries improper 'stand-ins for FIFA and Infantino,' arguing they have no direct legal interest since neither is a target of the contemplated Swiss case nor a recipient of UEFA's proposed subpoenas of Josh Kushner, Thrive Capital, and former Liberty Media CEO Greg Maffei; the court has not yet ruled on either the discovery application or the intervention motion. The filing follows FIFA's Sep 6 confirmation that Infantino will stand for a fourth term at the March 18, 2027 Congress in Rabat, with no formal challenger yet declared ahead of the Nov 18 candidacy deadline.
